[7AM] #LagIbdExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

Traffic is good coming inward Otedola bridge down to Tollgate and Alapere-Ogudu.
Ifako towards Iyana Oworo is also encouraging.
Connecting the Third mainland bridge en route Adekunle is good.
Traffic moves gradually from Adekunle towards Adeniji.
Adenijji through Ilubirin to connect Sura is better.

The return journey on the Third mainland bridge back to Iyana Oworo, Tollgate and Otedola bridge is good for now.
Traffic has also subsided beyond Otedola bridge towards Berger.
But a gradual flow approaching Berger and New Garage towards the incident scene on Kara bridge.

Patience is very vital.
Drive cautiously!

data.text:
[8:12AM] 
#Agege
#TrafficUpdate

Good Movement on Old Abeokuta road from Abattoir down to Nitel connecting Total underneath the bridge is busy due to alternation and pedestrian crossing.
The stretch of Old ipaja road from NYSC inward Olufunlayo down to Agbotikuyo is at a fast rate with minor delay approaching Shofunde inward Okekoto due to alternation.

Alfa Nla Inward Oniwaya junction down to Capitol is at a fast pace.
Mangoro Ashade inward Akanni Doherty connecting Guinness is busy due to uneven portions of the road.

Pen cinema bridge Inward Oba Ogunji is at a fast pace with minor delay at Odo Eran due to alternation.

The stretch of Metal box inward Acme junction down to Fumec is busy due to early morning rush.
Akilo inward Mobil Ashade is at a fast pace  connecting Oba Akran down to Dangote U turn is busy due to early morning rush.

The earlier reported loaded 40ft containerized truck on Oba Akran inward Ikeja still awaits evacuation as it cannot be towed meanwhile effort is on by the owner for evacuation and it's expected to be done soon.
